sources.note: Seat Weißenthurm, Amtsgericht Koblenz VR 11284, recognised under § 15 WaffG as printed on the title page. The document names no international federation membership. The DSU also publishes the sheets for K 18 to K 23 and the Admiral-Pokal (2024, headed "DSU Sporthandbuch, Kurzwaffen") on d-s-u.de; the list of approved rule books of the Bundesverwaltungsamt shows only the 2018 handbook for the DSU (04.05.2018), so those sheets are not a rule book of this record.
